news.headline: SBI Q2 Results Preview: PATmay rise up to 25% YoY; NII, margins, deposit growth in focus
news.summary: State Bank of India will announce Q2FY27 results on November 3, with brokerages forecasting 11-13% NII growth and up to 25.2% profit growth. Investors will track margins, loan growth, deposits, credit costs and asset quality.

news.headline: Goldman Sachs expects Bank of England to raise rates again in February
news.summary: Goldman Sachs has revised its outlook on the Bank of England's interest rates, now predicting a possible quarter-point rise in November's monetary policy meeting. This would be the first increase since 2023, influenced by climbing energy costs and robust economic growth. Although immediate policy shifts are unlikely, the Bank will vigilantly observe inflation risks, maintaining rates at 4.25% through mid-next year.

news.headline: South Eastern Coalfields files DRHP with SEBI for IPO; Coal India to offload 66.8 crore shares
news.summary: Coal India subsidiary South Eastern Coalfields has filed its draft papers with SEBI for an IPO comprising an offer for sale of up to 66.81 crore shares. One of India’s largest coal producers, SECL reported higher revenue and profit and plans to list on the BSE and NSE.

news.headline: Coforge among 4 stocks that hit 52-week highs and rallied up to 15% in a month
news.summary: Four BSE 100 stocks, Coforge, Eternal, Indian Hotels Company and Kotak Mahindra Bank, touched fresh 52-week highs as the Sensex surged over 1,200 points. All four stocks also delivered positive returns over the past month.

news.headline: Diwali cheer! Mukesh Ambani gets $8.5 billion richer in a day as RIL shares soar
news.summary: Mukesh Ambani experienced a significant increase in wealth following a rally in Reliance Industries shares. The company's stock rose by 11.64%, marking its strongest gain in over six years. Reliance's quarterly earnings surpassed expectations, especially in its oil-to-chemicals and telecom sectors. Analysts have since shown increased optimism about the company's financial outlook and growth prospects. However, challenges remain for Reliance's retail business and overall stock recovery.

news.headline: Explained: Why gold investors should tone down expectations as yellow metal plunges to a 1-year low
news.summary: Gold has fallen more than 30% from its January record high, with rising oil prices, inflation concerns and expectations of further Fed rate hikes adding to pressure. Analysts remain cautious about a near-term recovery, even as major banks retain bullish forecasts for 2027.

news.headline: GAIL shares jump 4% as Q2 net profit rises over 8% to Rs 4,650 crore, revenue grows 17%
news.summary: GAIL shares rose nearly 4% after the company reported strong second-quarter profit and revenue growth, supported by its gas marketing and transmission businesses. Investor sentiment was also buoyed by the board’s in-principle approval to list subsidiary GAIL Gas through an IPO.

news.headline: Reliance Industries shares skyrocket 12%, record biggest single-day jump since April 2020 as Q2 earnings spark Rs 2 lakh cr rally
news.summary: Reliance Industries shares surged nearly 12% after reporting outstanding Q2 results for FY27. The company announced a massive 41% yearly increase in net profit to Rs 25,548 crore, alongside a 29% rise in revenue to Rs 3.32 lakh crore. Many international brokers are holding onto 'Buy' ratings, anticipating considerable upside for the stock. These recent gains have helped Reliance rebound from a 52-week low recorded earlier this month.

news.headline: Reliance Industries shares rally 6% after Q2 results. Here’s why Jefferies, others analysts see up to 47% upside
news.summary: Reliance Industries shares rose up to 6% after the company reported a 41% YoY increase in Q2 net profit to Rs 25,548 crore, while revenue climbed 29% to Rs 3.32 lakh crore. The O2C business led earnings growth, with EBITDA surging 68% YoY to a record Rs 25,203 crore, supported by strong refining and petrochemical performance.

news.headline: Bank of Baroda shares jump 5% after Q2 net profit rises 36%. What Nomura and other brokerages saying?
news.summary: Bank of Baroda reported a 36% year-on-year rise in Q2 FY27 net profit, aided by gains from the NSE stake sale. Brokerages maintained mixed ratings, with target prices ranging from Rs 260 to Rs 285 per share.

news.headline: Missed Reliance Industries’ historic 12% one-day rally? Here’s what technical analysts are saying
news.summary: Reliance Industries experienced a remarkable increase in share price after reporting impressive Q2 earnings, which significantly boosted its market capitalization. The firm’s net profit surged by 41% year-over-year, fueled by strong performances in its oil-to-chemicals and digital services segments. Analysts express optimism, with several brokerages setting ambitious target prices. Current technical indicators also reveal a favorable price trajectory, suggesting room for further growth following this positive oil sector performance.

news.headline: Bitcoin rattled by biggest crypto heist in history! Why Warren Buffett and Charlie Munger hated cryptocurrency
news.summary: A reported $6 billion crypto heist at Binance has rattled investors and revived concerns about cryptocurrency risks. Binance said its initial investigation pointed to a compromised DevOps engineer’s laptop, which may have enabled unauthorised withdrawals. The FBI blamed North Korea for the attack, while Binance said it would cover the losses.

news.headline: Big tech share buybacks plunge 83% as AI spending hits cash flows
news.summary: Major US technology companies sharply reduced dividends and share buybacks as record AI infrastructure spending pushed their combined free cash flow into deficit. The shift raises concerns about shareholder returns and places greater pressure on Big Tech to deliver profit growth from its AI investments.

news.headline: Vedanta Oil and Gas shares jump 14% in 2 days, m-cap swells by Rs 1,600 crore after Q2 results
news.summary: Vedanta Oil and Gas shares jumped 6% on Monday after rallying 8.5% in the previous session, adding nearly Rs 1,600 crore to its market capitalisation. The gains followed a strong Q2 performance, with the company reporting a net profit of Rs 746 crore against a loss of Rs 91 crore a year ago, despite a sequential decline.

news.headline: India bonds surge as oil cools on US-Iran deal hopes
news.summary: Indian government bonds showed improvement as crude oil prices declined, which is expected to boost market demand. Traders are closely monitoring the upcoming US midterm elections for potential impacts on oil prices and economic policies. The falling crude prices are expected to alleviate inflation concerns and fiscal pressures for India. Furthermore, the Reserve Bank of India may adjust its interest rate plans based on these developments.
